method: Independent source inspection and cross-component interface review; no mainnet RPC, signing, secret provisioning, GitHub or OAuth actions by this reviewer.
assessment: No identified path redirects user escrow or worker credits to a caller-selected recipient in the reviewed sources. This is a scoped review, not a formal audit.
The executor captures the target facts and prompt on-chain, pins engine/model/adapter/codec runtime identities, and accepts only actual engine output tokens through its strict codec.
Escrow is conserved as remaining job budget plus worker or owner pull credits. Cancellation and refund are owner-only. Refunding and withdrawing require separate owner transactions.

Browser quotes bind the serialized transaction request, owner, chain, target code hash, value, gas reserve and expiry; identity, balance, dependencies, fee and gas estimate are checked again before requesting a signature.

The worker uses one fixed chain, reviewed executor and frozen model. Its public trigger accepts only a job ID. It signs only continuation, finalization and withdrawal of its own credits; it supplies no model weights, features or reports.

Production nonce coordination uses a SQL signer-wide fenced lease and pending record. Signed bytes are privately journaled before broadcast and strongly read back. Recovery may broadcast exactly those original bytes at most twice total, never change nonce, destination, calldata, value or fees.
The deployment script checks frozen sources, model payloads and all shard runtime identities, predicted addresses, individual transaction identities and final dependency/configuration pins.

resolvedFindings.resolution: Capped mode checks its total forecast and balance before signing. The separately selected market mode intentionally has no cumulative monetary cap or gas-price ceiling.
Final verification covers complete shard registry/payload, model configuration and all executor immutable getters. Exact codec runtime/source also pins its schema.
Health emits both ready and available; browser and UI consume the same service status.
A duplicate worker invocation no longer persists an unscheduled busy status over the active job.
Bounded exact-signed-byte recovery handles durable prepare followed by process loss without signing a replacement.
Browser preserves pending recovery state and the actual known hash when storage fails after wallet submission or receipt handling.
Cancel/refund/withdraw verify the executor directly and remain available if an inference dependency fails identity verification.
UI explicitly identifies the budget as an estimate that may pause and require a separately reviewed top-up.
Manual advance/finalize submission gas-price padding is additionally clamped to the on-chain job fee ceiling.
Accepted quotes decode the internal retained serialization and validate retained owner/chain/expiry; active caller serialization cannot replace transaction fields.
Production health is bound to exact model ID in addition to chain and executor.
Final opening affordability is checked after nonce lookup and preserves the separately quoted recovery fee reserve in the wallet.
A failed mandatory pre-send persistence rolls back the unsent intent and makes no wallet request. Post-send errors retain the exact known hash.

Approved private transport is stdin-only, restricted to the fixed HTTPS Alchemy origin/token path with no userinfo/query/fragment, redacted from errors and absent from persisted journal URLs. Broadcast remains single-attempt.
Market-mode simulation omits stale explicit price; signing refreshes the RPC market quote and applies fixed5% headroom. Affordability and canonical receipts use that exact signed price.
Runtime now requires a reviewed nonzero deployer and rejects the same worker address, without relying on optional metadata.
Setup GET reports ready:false/available:false and verifies deployment plus DB/Blob read access without loading the signing key, writing rows/objects or broadcasting.

Manual proof accepts positive actual Nitro receipt price up to the exact signed price; fee accounting uses the actual receipt price. Prior equality would incorrectly stop after a real successful spend.
Manual resume and final PASS revalidate exact signed raw bytes, transaction, canonical receipts and the cumulative fee sum. Canonical executor logs and signed method/job identify actual paid credit.

Core remains strict by default. Explicit policy is capped at5bps and floor-rounds actual fees, requires positive actual paid credit, rejects reverted/over-limit receipts, and checks newly settled and recovered receipts.
Manual proof uses a0.5ETH lifetime actual-network-fee budget. Opening, advance/finalize, refund and withdrawal all count; the full next signed reserve must fit before each new send.

pendingBeforeUnattendedProductionClaim: Explicit authorization and successful provisioning of a separate persistent mainnet worker signer; automatic approval review rejected the attempted new signer provisioning. No workaround was attempted by this reviewer.
Production worker key must remain limited to the Functions scope and production context, with the required reviewed nonzero deployer distinct from the pinned worker.

Validate actual SQL migration and signer lease/conflict/pending behavior, private immutable Blobs write/readback, published background invocation and scheduled resume across process loss. Disabled setup GET verifies read access only.
Keep worker.serviceVerified false and block normal one-approval funding while the production service is unverified.
scopeLimits: Source review does not establish model accuracy, broad arbitrary-address reasoning or AIXBT-level capabilities. This is a finite14-signal observation model.

The calibrated deposit is an operational estimate, not a proof that every job finishes within that budget. Longer attention contexts and Nitro posting costs require explicit reserve and pause policies.
The worker lifetime fee policy and available float can halt continuation; capped reimbursement need not cover every actual network cost.

Market deployment mode remains finite51 planned zero-value creation operations but has no monetary ceiling below the signer balance and can leave a partial deployment if later fees or funding prevent progress.
Two exact-byte broadcast attempts do not guarantee delivery during a persistent RPC outage; ambiguous or nonce-conflicting operations stop for original-hash reconciliation.

A0.00025ETH bound follows for the sum of tolerated paid-receipt shortfalls under the0.5ETH fee budget. It is not an unconditional bound on realized loss: an over-limit or reverted transaction has already spent its actual fee before the sender detects it and pauses.
Owner opening/refund and worker withdrawals are operating fees within the same lifetime manual-proof fee budget. No profitability is claimed. The manual proof budget is separate from deployment fees.

The core shortfall checks apply to newly settled/recovered paid receipts. Manual proof additionally revalidates all historical policy from canonical logs on resume and before final PASS. Production crash/queue behavior still needs real platform validation.

The owner was also the one-off manual worker. Escrow reimbursements and unused escrow returned to the same owner; these are not evidence that a separate production worker has been provisioned.
